capabilities: Captures pasted and dropped attachments into the note's dedicated folder
Syncs the attachment folder when a note is renamed or moved
Batch-updates .md and .canvas links in one pass with a single notice
Trashes the attachment folder when the note is deleted
Organizes existing attachments selectively or vault-wide
extras: Uses only official Obsidian APIs; works on desktop and mobile with zero telemetry or network requests.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in Default location for new attachments setting falls short
problem: Obsidian's built-in attachment location settings cannot give each note its own self-contained folder, and renaming or moving a note leaves static attachment folders behind.
summary: Saves pasted and dropped attachments into a folder named after the note, and keeps that folder and all links in sync when notes are renamed, moved, or deleted.
